failure_pattern: Legitimate banking login portal with official bank domain (.sbi) flagged due to 'login' and 'sbi' co-occurring frequently in phishing URLs.
target_mitigation: Add authentic official bank portal URLs and login pages across major Indian banks (.sbi, .hdfcbank.com, .icicibank.com, .axisbank.com, .bankofbaroda.in) as hard negatives.

content: तुमचा फ्लिपकार्ट ऑर्डर रवाना करण्यात आला आहे. ट्रॅकिंगसाठी अधिकृत ॲप तपासा.
failure_pattern: Legitimate Marathi e-commerce delivery notification flagged due to common Marathi auxiliary verbs/postpositions being skewed toward scams because Marathi benign samples were scarce.
target_mitigation: Expand Marathi hard negatives for delivery, government, utility, and everyday communications.

content: माँ, मैं ठीक हूँ। आज रात हॉस्टल में थोड़ा काम है इसलिए देर से बात करूंगा। आप अपनी दवाइयां समय पर ले लेना।
failure_pattern: Everyday personal Hindi family message flagged because common Hindi functional words ('पर', 'कर', 'अपन') lacked negative reinforcement in benign training data.
target_mitigation: Add conversational and personal Hindi/Hinglish communications, family check-ins, and workplace messages.

content: आरबीआई कहता है: जानकार बनिए, सतर्क रहिए। अपना यूपीआई पिन केवल पैसे भेजने के लिए दर्ज करें, पैसे प्राप्त करने के लिए पिन की आवश्यकता नहीं होती। किसी भी अनजान लिंक पर क्लिक न करें।
failure_pattern: Authentic RBI public cybersecurity awareness message flagged because it mentions fraud warning terms ('यूपीआई पिन', 'अनजान लिंक', 'क्लिक न करें').
target_mitigation: Incorporate official CERT-In, RBI Kehta Hai, and NPCI public awareness advisories as explicit hard-negative samples.

content: Savdhan: OLX par payment lene ke liye kabhi QR code scan na kare aur UPI PIN na dale. Paise lene ke liye PIN nahi lagta.
failure_pattern: Hinglish peer-to-peer safety advisory warning users that receiving money does not require entering a PIN; flagged due to terminology overlap ('QR code', 'UPI PIN').
target_mitigation: Add peer-to-peer safety advice, banking precautions, and fraud awareness warnings across Hinglish and Romanized Indic.
